decisions.rationale: Die Originalbänder bleiben sichtbar: Lane A bewertet die duale Silikon- plus kationische Polymerpersistenz als high, Lane B begrenzt sie wegen der ungewöhnlich starken Reset-Seite auf moderate. Die finale Abwägung folgt moderate.
decisions.whyThisBand: Dual silicone + cationic guar rejects low, but unusually strong SLES/SLS/CAPB plus TEA-dodecylbenzenesulfonate reset bounds the persistent stack; no rich 2-in-1/oil/fatty architecture makes high less supported.
decisions.whyNotNeighborBand: Low would ignore both silicone signals and the cationic guar route. High would require stronger support for net persistence after the unusually strong multi-anionic reset, such as a richer 2-in-1, oil, or fatty-conditioning architecture.

classificationConfidence.limitingFactor: The exact formula is supported by current German sources, but INCI cannot quantify the net balance of silicone deposition and unusually strong cleansing.
